descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Cubus 2: Colors is an immersive VR puzzle experience built around color logic, spatial thinking, and fast decision-making.

You begin with simple learning levels using three primary colors — yellow, red, and blue. Grab cubes with your hands, throw them onto a color table, and collect tiles by matching colors correctly.

As you progress, the challenge evolves.

In advanced levels, success depends on mixing colors in mid-air, creating new colors before throwing them to the table. Precision, timing, and color knowledge become essential as the game introduces mixed-color challenges and tighter time limits.

Super Intelligence levels remove all primary colors entirely — only mixed colors remain. These levels demand full mastery of color combinations and quick thinking under pressure.

The game features:

Infinite levels with adaptive difficulty.

Performance-based progression starting from level 6.

Time-limited challenges that reward efficiency.

A smooth onboarding phase that learns how you play.

Whether you’re learning color logic or pushing your limits in high-skill challenges, Cubus 2: Colors continuously adapts to keep you engaged.
